parameters.name: Architecture
parameters.description:
The system architecture. Valid values: 

- i386.
- x86_64.
- arm64.

Default value: x86_64.

parameters.name: BootMode
parameters.description:
The boot mode of the image. Valid values:

- BIOS: Basic Input/Output System (BIOS) boot mode.
- UEFI: Unified Extensible Firmware Interface (UEFI) boot mode.

Default value: BIOS. If `Architecture=arm64`, the default value is UEFI, and only UEFI can be specified.

<notice>

To prevent instances from failing to start due to an unsupported boot mode, make sure that you understand the boot mode supported by the target image before you specify this parameter. For more information about image boot modes, see [Image boot modes](~~2244655#b9caa9b8bb1wf~~).

</notice>

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the image. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: DetectionStrategy
parameters.description:
The image detection strategy. If this parameter is not specified, detection is not triggered. Only the Standard detection mode is supported.

>Most Linux/Windows versions are supported. For more information about image detection items and operating system limitations, see [Overview of image detection](~~439819~~) and [Operating system limitations for image detection](~~475800~~).

parameters.name: DiskDeviceMapping
parameters.description: The information list of the custom image to create.

sub_parameters.name: Device
sub_parameters.description:
The device name of DiskDeviceMapping.N.Device in the custom image.

> This parameter will be deprecated. For better code compatibility, do not use this parameter.

sub_parameters.name: DiskImSize
sub_parameters.description:
The size of the custom image. Unit: GiB.

The space consists of the system disk and data disks. Make sure that the system disk space is greater than or equal to the size of the imported image file. Valid values:

- When N=1, the value indicates the system disk. Valid values: 1 GiB to 2048 GiB.
- When N=2 to 17, the value indicates a data disk. Valid values: 1 GiB to 2048 GiB.

After you upload the source image file to OSS, you can view the image file size in the OSS bucket.

>This parameter will be deprecated. For better compatibility, use `DiskDeviceMapping.N.DiskImageSize` instead.

sub_parameters.name: DiskImageSize
sub_parameters.description:
The space size of the custom image after the image is imported.

The space consists of the system disk and data disks. Make sure that the system disk space is greater than or equal to the size of the imported image file. Valid values:

- When N=1, the value indicates the system disk. Valid values: 1 GiB to 2048 GiB.
- When N=2 to 17, the value indicates a data disk. Valid values: 1 GiB to 2048 GiB.

After you upload the source image file to OSS, you can view the image file size in the OSS bucket.

sub_parameters.name: Format
sub_parameters.description:
The image format. Valid values:

- RAW.
- VHD.
- QCOW2.
- VMDK (in invitational preview).

Default value: empty, which indicates that Alibaba Cloud automatically detects the image format and uses the detected format.

sub_parameters.name: OSSBucket
sub_parameters.description:
The OSS bucket where the image file is stored.

> Before importing an image to this OSS bucket for the first time, add the RAM authorization policy as described in the **Operation description** section of this topic. Otherwise, the `NoSetRoletoECSServiceAccount` error is reported.

sub_parameters.name: OSSObject
sub_parameters.description: The name (key) of the image file stored in the OSS bucket after the image is uploaded to OSS.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:

- true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including the AccessKey validity, the authorization of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, and required parameters. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
- false: performs a dry run and sends the Normal request. If the check succeeds, a 2XX HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: ImageName
parameters.description: The image name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, periods (.), colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-).

parameters.name: LicenseType
parameters.description:
The license type. This parameter specifies the authorization mode when instances are created by calling [RunInstances](~~2679677~~) with this image. This value takes effect only for Windows Server images. Valid values:
- Aliyun: Uses the Alibaba Cloud official license. After the instance starts, the system attempts to automatically connect to the Alibaba Cloud KMS server for activation. The billing for the instance includes the Windows Server license fee.
- BYOL: Bring Your Own License. After the instance starts, Alibaba Cloud does not automatically activate it. You must manually activate it by using your own valid license key. The billing for the instance does not include the Windows Server license fee.

Default value: Aliyun.

parameters.name: OSType
parameters.description:
The operating system type. Valid values: 

- windows. You must also set `LicenseType`.
- linux.

Default value: linux.

parameters.name: Platform
parameters.description:
The operating system distribution. Valid values: 
- Aliyun
- Anolis
- CentOS
- Ubuntu
- CoreOS
- SUSE
- Debian
- OpenSUSE
- FreeBSD
- RedHat
- Kylin
- UOS
- Fedora
- Fedora CoreOS
- CentOS Stream
- AlmaLinux
- Rocky Linux
- Gentoo
- Customized Linux
- Others Linux
- Windows Server 2022
- Windows Server 2019
- Windows Server 2016
- Windows Server 2012
- Windows Server 2008
- Windows Server 2003
- Other Windows

Default value: Others Linux.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the source custom image. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the enterprise resource group to which the imported image belongs.

parameters.name: RoleName
parameters.description: The name of the RAM role used to import the image.

parameters.name: StorageLocationArn
parameters.description:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the CloudBox, which uniquely identifies the cloud storage location.

>You need to specify this parameter only when you import an image file from OSS on CloudBox. If you are not using OSS on CloudBox, do not set this parameter. For more information, see [What is OSS on CloudBox](~~430190~~).

The correct ARN format is: `arn:acs:cloudbox:{RegionId}:{AliUid}:cloudbox/{CloudBoxId}`, where `{RegionId}` is the region ID where the CloudBox resides, `{AliUid}` is the Alibaba Cloud account ID, and `{CloudBoxId}` is the CloudBox ID.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag list of the image.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the image. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the image. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
